sellerHelp.title: Help Center & Marketplace Guide
sellerHelp.subtitle: Complete guide for Sellers, Landlords, Buyers & Renters
sellerHelp.step1Desc: Create one account to list products for sale or rent out properties.
sellerHelp.step2Desc: Select 'For Sale' or 'For Rent (Landlord)' and upload 2 to 4 clear photos.
sellerHelp.step3Desc: Enter price or monthly rent, deposit, lease period, and location.
sellerHelp.step4Desc: Admin verifies listing quality. Once approved, it appears live instantly.
sellerHelp.imageRule1: Minimum 2 images required, maximum 4 depending on tier.
sellerHelp.imageRule2: Landlords: include interior, exterior, and bathroom/kitchen photos.
sellerHelp.imageRule3: Sellers: show item from multiple angles in good lighting.
sellerHelp.tip1: Provide honest titles and precise monthly rent/sale price.
sellerHelp.tip2: Landlords: specify clear deposit terms and availability date.
sellerHelp.tip3: Accurate location tag helps buyers and renters find you faster.
sellerHelp.tip4: If rejected, check admin notes in your dashboard to re-list.
sellerHelp.faq1q: How do I list a property or item for Rent as a Landlord?
sellerHelp.faq1a: Switch to 'For Rent (Landlord)' mode on the listing form. Fill in monthly rent (ETB), security deposit, minimum lease term, and available date.
sellerHelp.faq2q: Do Buyers or Renters need to register an account?
sellerHelp.faq2a: No! Buyers and Renters can freely search, filter by location, view full photos, and contact landlords or sellers without registering.
sellerHelp.faq3q: Can I be both a Seller and a Landlord on one account?
sellerHelp.faq3a: Yes! A single user account allows you to post both items for sale and rental properties/tools without separate logins.
sellerHelp.faq4q: How many photos can I upload per listing?
sellerHelp.faq4a: Normal tier allows 2 photos, Gold tier allows 3 photos, and Premium tier allows 4 photos per listing. Minimum 2 photos are required.
sellerHelp.faq5q: How does the rental security deposit work?
sellerHelp.faq5a: Landlords set a deposit amount during listing creation. Renters review deposit terms on the product page before contacting the landlord.

help_page.title: Help Center
help_page.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or reach out to our support team.
help_page.step1_desc: Search or filter products by category, price, condition, and location.
help_page.step2_desc: Call the seller directly using the phone number shown on the listing.
help_page.step3_desc: Confirm your order through the platform and arrange delivery with the seller.
help_page.tip1: Always meet in a public, well-lit place when exchanging goods.
help_page.tip2: Never send money before seeing the product in person.
help_page.tip3: Check the product condition carefully before completing payment.
help_page.tip4: Report any suspicious listings using the flag icon.
help_page.tip5: Do not share your personal ID or bank details with sellers.
help_page.faq1q: How do I buy a product?
help_page.faq1a: Browse products on the Buy page, click on any item to view details, then click the Buy button to confirm your order. The seller will contact you to arrange delivery.
help_page.faq2q: How do I list a product for sale?
help_page.faq2a: Click the Sell button in the header or on the home page. Fill in the product title, description, price, category, condition, and upload a photo. Submit to publish your listing.
help_page.faq3q: Is payment done online or in person?
help_page.faq3a: Payment confirmation is done through the platform, but final delivery and cash exchange is arranged directly between buyer and seller. Always meet in a safe public place.
help_page.faq4q: How do I contact the seller?
help_page.faq4a: Each product listing shows the seller's phone number. You can call or message them directly. Our company support number is also available on the Contact page.
help_page.faq5a: Yes! HUNTIQ supports both new and used items. When listing, select Used under the Condition field so buyers know the item's state.
help_page.faq6q: How do I report a suspicious listing?
help_page.faq6a: Click the flag icon on any product card or inside the product detail view. Fill in the reason and submit. Our team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
help_page.faq7a: We support Electronics, Vehicles, Property, Home Appliances, Furniture, Clothing, Agriculture, Industry, Construction, Services, Jobs, Animals, Food, Health & Beauty, Sports, Education, Entertainment, Business, Luxury, and Miscellaneous.
help_page.faq8q: How do I change the language?
help_page.faq8a: Click the globe icon in the top navigation bar. You can switch between Amharic, English, Afaan Oromoo, and Tigrinya at any time.
help_page.faq9q: How do I save a search?
help_page.faq9a: After applying filters on the Browse page, click Save Search. Give it a name and it will appear in your Profile under Saved Searches for quick access later.
help_page.faq10a: We only store the minimum data needed to run the platform. Your phone number is only visible on listings you create. Read our Privacy Policy for full details.
help_page.contact_support_desc: Our Ethiopian customer care team is available 7 days a week to assist you.
help_page.safe_exchange_subtitle: Follow these golden rules for every marketplace transaction
help_page.safe_exchange_p1: Always meet in busy, well-lit public hubs (Bole, Piassa, Mexico, Megenagna, or regional city centers) during daylight hours.
help_page.safe_exchange_p2: Inspect devices, vehicles, or items thoroughly before completing Telebirr or CBE Birr transfers. Never share SMS OTP codes or mobile banking PINs.
help_page.no_faq_found: No questions match your search. Try different terms or reach out to our team.
help_page.faq_rent_q: How does property and vehicle renting work on HUNTIQ?
help_page.faq_rent_a: Landlords and verified rental agencies list apartments, villas, and vehicles with transparent daily or monthly rates. Renters can call the host directly, arrange an in-person viewing, and sign agreements without middleman markups.
help_page.faq_pay_q: What payment methods are supported for orders?
help_page.faq_pay_a: We support Ethiopian mobile payments including Telebirr, CBE Birr, Bank of Abyssinia, Awash Bank, and Cash on Delivery upon physical inspection.
help_page.faq_verify_q: What does the Verified Seller badge mean?
help_page.faq_verify_a: Verified sellers have provided authenticated Ethiopian National ID (Fayda / Kebele), commercial TIN registration, or physical store location validation by our verification team.
help_page.faq_dispute_q: What should I do if an item does not match its description?
help_page.faq_dispute_a: Inspect all items before handing over money or releasing transfer. If an issue occurs, report the listing immediately via the Flag icon or contact customer support with your order reference.

about_page.title: About HUNTIQ
about_page.description: HUNTIQ is the premier platform for buying and selling anything in Ethiopia. Our mission is to make trade easy, secure, and accessible for everyone.
about_page.mission_text1: HUNTIQ was founded to solve a simple problem — finding quality goods in Ethiopia was difficult, scattered, and unreliable. We built a single trusted platform where anyone can buy or sell with confidence, in their own language, from anywhere in the country.
about_page.mission_text2: We believe every Ethiopian family deserves access to a fair, transparent marketplace. Whether you are furnishing a new home, upgrading your tools, or selling items you no longer need — HUNTIQ is your partner.
about_page.value_secure_desc: Every listing is verified and reports are reviewed within 24 hours.
about_page.value_fast_desc: Find what you need in seconds with smart search and filters.
about_page.value_local_desc: Available in Amharic, English, Afaan Oromoo, and Tigrinya.
about_page.value_community_desc: Built for Ethiopian families and businesses to trade with trust.
about_page.location_city: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia — Open Mon–Sat, 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM

terms_page.title: Terms & Conditions
terms_page.content: By using HUNTIQ, you agree to follow our guidelines. All users must provide accurate information when listing products. We reserve the right to remove any fraudulent or prohibited content. Transactions are between buyers and sellers directly.
terms_page.s1_content: By accessing or using HUNTIQ, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms_page.s2_content: All users must provide accurate and truthful information when creating listings. You are responsible for the products you list and the transactions you enter into. Misrepresentation of products is strictly prohibited.
terms_page.s3_content: You may not list illegal items, counterfeit goods, stolen property, or any content that violates Ethiopian law. We reserve the right to remove any listing without notice.
terms_page.s4_content: HUNTIQ facilitates connections between buyers and sellers. All transactions are directly between the two parties. We are not responsible for disputes arising from individual transactions.
terms_page.s5_content: Payment confirmation is processed through the platform. Final payment and delivery arrangements are made directly between buyer and seller. Always verify the product before completing payment.
terms_page.s6_content: Users may leave honest reviews for products and sellers. Fake, misleading, or abusive reviews are not allowed and will be removed. Repeated violations may result in account suspension.
terms_page.s7_content: All content on this platform, including logos, design, and code, is the property of HUNTIQ. You may not copy or reproduce any part without written permission.
terms_page.s8_content: HUNTIQ is not liable for any loss, damage, or injury resulting from transactions made through the platform. Use the service at your own risk.
terms_page.s9_content: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms_page.s10_content: For questions about these terms, contact us at support@example.com or call +000 00 000 0000.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.content: Your privacy is important to us. We only collect information necessary to provide our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Your location and contact info are only shared when you list products.
privacy_page.s1_content: We collect only the information you provide: your name, email, phone number when listing products, and browsing preferences such as language and currency. We do not collect payment card details.
privacy_page.s2_content: Your data is used to display your listings, save your preferences, and improve the platform experience. We do not use your data for advertising or sell it to third parties.
privacy_page.s3_content: Your phone number is visible only on listings you create. Your name and email are stored locally on your device and are not shared with other users unless you choose to display them.
privacy_page.s4_content: All data is stored securely. We use industry-standard practices to protect your information. However, no system is 100% secure — please use strong passwords and keep your device safe.
privacy_page.s5_content: We use browser local storage to save your language preference, theme, saved searches, and product listings. No tracking cookies are used. You can clear this data at any time from your browser settings.
privacy_page.s6_content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your data at any time. To request data deletion, contact us at support@example.com. We will process your request within 7 business days.
